entries.title: Job 8:1
segments: ¶And Bildad the Shuhite answered and said,

entries.title: Job 8:2
segments: How long wilt thou speak these things? and the words of thy mouth be a strong wind?

entries.title: Job 8:3
segments: Doth *God pervert judgment, and the Almighty pervert justice?

entries.title: Job 8:4
segments: If thy children have sinned against him, he hath also given them over into the hand of their transgression.

entries.title: Job 8:5
segments: If thou seek earnestly unto *God, and make thy supplication to the Almighty,

entries.title: Job 8:6
segments: If thou be pure and upright, surely now he will awake for thee, and make the habitation of thy righteousness prosperous;

entries.title: Job 8:7
segments: And though thy beginning was small, yet thine end shall be very great.

entries.title: Job 8:8
segments: ¶For inquire, I pray thee, of the former generation, and attend to the researches of their fathers;

entries.title: Job 8:9
segments: For we are [but] of yesterday, and know nothing, for our days upon earth are a shadow.

entries.title: Job 8:10
segments: Shall not they teach thee, [and] tell thee, and utter words out of their heart?

entries.title: Job 8:11
segments: Doth the papyrus shoot up without mire? doth the reed-grass grow without water?

entries.title: Job 8:12
segments: Whilst it is yet in its greenness [and] not cut down, it withereth before any [other] grass.

entries.title: Job 8:13
segments: So are the paths of all that forget *God; and the profane man's hope shall perish,

entries.title: Job 8:14
segments: Whose confidence shall be cut off, and his reliance is a spider's web.

entries.title: Job 8:15
segments: He shall lean upon his house, and it shall not stand; he shall lay hold on it, but it shall not endure.

entries.title: Job 8:16
segments: He is full of sap before the sun, and his sprout shooteth forth over his garden;

entries.title: Job 8:17
segments: His roots are entwined about the stoneheap; he seeth the place of stones.

entries.title: Job 8:18
segments: If he destroy him from his place, then it shall deny him: I have not seen thee!

entries.title: Job 8:19
segments: Behold, this is the joy of his way, and out of the dust shall others grow.

entries.title: Job 8:20
segments: ¶Behold, *God will not cast off a perfect man, neither will he take evil-doers by the hand.

entries.title: Job 8:21
segments: Whilst he would fill thy mouth with laughing and thy lips with shouting,

entries.title: Job 8:22
segments: They that hate thee shall be clothed with shame, and the tent of the wicked be no more.
